claim: AGENTENV INTEGRATION DELIVERED END-TO-END, ALL COMMANDS LIVE-VERIFIED. (1) Install: GitHub release download was unstable for the 75MB server tarball (install.sh curl timeout), so both release assets were pre-downloaded with resume (-C -), SHA256-verified against the release manifest, and installed manually (equivalent to install.sh: aenv CLI + server + ublk daemon + deps under /var/lib/aenv, dedicated aenv service account, setup-only + setup-host provisioning). Two service-start defects found and fixed en route: the hand-written systemd unit lacked AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_ADMIN+CAP_SYS_ADMIN (server refuses to start without them), and /var/lib/aenv/overlaybd needed aenv ownership. (2) Authentication: v0.1.3 changed from the main-tree TODO-only header check to real constant-time API-key validation; the server auto-generates the key at /var/lib/aenv/secrets/api-key (e2b_ prefix) and the CLI credentials file is a flat TOML at ~/.config/aenv/credentials. (3) Sandbox: docker.io is unreachable from this network (manifest fetch timeouts); dockerproxy.net mirror works -- template built ready in ~5 min, sandbox booted (Firecracker, kernel 6.1.175, 2 vCPU). (4) Interaction verified: aenv exec (single command + /bin/bash -c compound), aenv upload, aenv connect; VM-internal DNS needed a one-time fix (echo 8.8.8.8 > /etc/resolv.conf) before apt worked; python3 installed via aliyun mirror. (5) Softmax IN THE VM: 2000x1024 pure-Python softmax uploaded and executed, output streamed back, pass=True. (6) HOST vs VM performance: identical code, 3 runs each -- HOST 0.274/0.376/0.356s vs VM 1.428/0.220/0.258s: Firecracker microVM CPU overhead is negligible (KVM passthrough, no translation; ranges overlap within run noise). The simulator-speed token latencies are entirely gem5 instruction-level simulation, not virtualization. (7) README gains a complete Chinese section: manual install with checksums, systemd unit with the capability lines, real API-key auth, mirror-based template pull, VM interaction commands with the two documented traps (DNS + exec single-command), in-VM softmax with live output, the HOST/VM comparison table, and cleanup.

live_results.verdict: microVM CPU overhead negligible; gem5 simulation is the latency source
